notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Lurking Roper's toughness.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.
